rationale.complete: Round 1 done on a reduced scope (G51 + G38 replication, three natives), with a validated which-artifact state, an erasure re-acquisition analysis and a frozen confirm script; no holdout run.
rationale.faithfulness: The core prediction (coordinated units beat agent + own artifact) failed where the method has power; the natives failed or were uninformative; signatures not identifiable. C = 1, D = 0.
rationale.usefulness: A computable diagnostic (held-out coordination gain with an outside-reference null) and a design rule backed by an exogenous intervention: after erasures agents recover by re-reading their own artifact, so make work state legible per agent in its repo; group co-allocation is a field, not a lever.

one_line: No coordinated superagent: with a which-artifact state and real power, agent + own artifact stays the unit; agents re-read their own repo after erasures.

v2.claim: In the powered units (#51b-d) no coordination-defined composite of agents plus artifacts predicts members' next artifact better than agent + own artifact: a group store of strength rho >= 0.7 is excluded (power 0.95-1.00, size 0.5%), large-set co-allocation is matched by outsiders on the same artifacts (a shared field), and after 11k forced erasures members move to the group's artifact no more than at placebo calls (1.1% vs 1.2%), going mostly to their own (61%).
v2.scope: #51b-d powered; G38, NE42, #44, #focus underpowered and consistent; stores of rho ~ 0.5 disfavoured but not excluded (power 0.60-0.75)

raters.claim: Scope: G51 (#51b-d powered) and G38, plus NE42, #44, #focus. No coordinated group of agents plus artifacts predicts members' next artifact better than agent + own artifact where the method has power; group co-allocation behaves as a shared field, and after erasures agents return to their own artifact.

ladder.factor: underpowered for the negative: power 0.60-0.75 only in #51b-d (<0.8)

v2.adjudication_note: Evidence weighting and the power rule: the coordinator stacked synthetic identification, partial replication, H01 as cross-hypothesis replication and the erasure intervention (p 0.76); the blind rater applied the negative-claim rule (power 0.60-0.75 < 0.8 at rho 0.5) and credited only the null (p 0.44). Ruling: scope the negative to rho >= 0.7, where power is 0.95-1.00, which satisfies the rule; count the synthetic once; drop H01, whose binary state had <= 7% power and so cannot replicate; and credit NE41 only as partly consistent.
